fundamental.summary: LW shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying engagement, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; historical small purchases by junior members lack conviction; market fear (43 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but absence of recent news data and stale congressional activity (330+ days) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (238.7) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 36 days present binary event risk; Consumer Staples defensive positioning offers limited protection in this environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 extreme overbought (80.41), 15x volume spike, and TEMA cross-up create technical momentum setup with price near 52-week highs in fear-zone contrarian environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R), weak trend strength (ADX 20.86), zero fundamental support, earnings binary event in 36 days, inverted yield curve, and VIX crisis levels (238.7) create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (RSI-9 spike, 15x volume, TEMA cross) offers short-term bullish setup in fear-zone environment. However, extreme overbought conditions, weak trend strength (ADX 20.86), and zero fundamental support create asymmetric risk that does not justify new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 36 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (238.7), and extreme overbought technicals create high probability of pullback or gap-down move before earnings catalyst.
decision.recommended_exit: If entry forced: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at RSI-9 < 50 or break below 20-day SMA.
